technique_name: Analyze the following piece of text and explain why it would be considered persuasive.
description: This piece of text is persuasive because it is making an implied statement about Amazon's customer service being the gold standard, without any evidence to back it up. This could lead readers to believe that Amazon is trustworthy and to create an association in the reader's mind of Amazon being an authority on customer service. example: Text: Did you know that Amazon has been the gold standard in customer service since its inception in 1994?
